in_marathi.name: Sushanth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good, Auspicious, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sushanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sushant means one who is Auspicious, Good, and has Prosperity. He is a God who is the preserver and the destroyer. He is the embodiment of Good Fortune and the one who imparts Strength and Victory.
